title: [WT-12] Wrappers: board history snapshots on refs/moe/board
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §4.

Objective: in worktree mode, board history (.moe/tasks, .moe/epics, .moe/project.json) moves off main onto one plumbing-written ref. Main never changes a .moe path, so the control checkout's fast-forward (WT-13) never collides with files the daemon keeps dirty.

Deliverable, in scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 as twins: board_snapshot / Invoke-MoeBoardSnapshot.
- It runs after L12 of every worktree-mode completion landing and after every worktree-mode QA post-flight, gated by settings.commitBoardState (default on).
- Steps:
  - a temp index read from the refs/moe/board tree (empty when unborn);
  - add every file under those paths that parses as JSON (one that does not parse keeps its parent blob and is named in the log line);
  - write-tree; commit-tree -p <old> with message 'board: <taskId> <status>';
  - `update-ref refs/moe/board <new> <old>`, 3 attempts, then MOE_BOARD_SNAPSHOT_SKIPPED;
  - a tree equal to the parent's writes nothing.
- Best-effort `git push origin refs/moe/board:refs/moe/board` with no force; a failure prints MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED.
- The wrapper only READS the daemon's files: it never writes under .moe/ (epic rail 3).
- Shared mode keeps today's BOARD tier unchanged.
- Cases in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and postflight.ps1. Depends on WT-11 (task-dd1ee586b90d4fc785434454b1423e76).

NOT in scope: untracking .moe/tasks on main (rejected in §4); daemon changes; docs (WT-17/WT-18).

Verification: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh (and on a Windows seat: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell)
definitionOfDone: postflight case (both harnesses): after a worktree completion landing, refs/moe/board's tree contains the control checkout's .moe/tasks/*.json, .moe/epics/*.json and .moe/project.json, and the landed commit C on main changes no .moe path.
postflight case: a truncated (unparsable) task JSON keeps its previous blob in the new snapshot and is named in the log; an unchanged board writes no new commit.
postflight case: a CAS race on refs/moe/board exhausting 3 attempts prints MOE_BOARD_SNAPSHOT_SKIPPED and the landing still counts; a failing push prints MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED.
postflight case: commitBoardState=false makes no snapshot; the .moe/ directory's mtimes and contents are unchanged by the wrapper (read-only).
Existing shared-mode BOARD-tier cases pass unchanged; both wrappers carry the same MOE_WORKTREE_/MOE_LAND_/MOE_CONTROL_/MOE_BOARD_ codes; the verification command exits 0.

implementationPlan.note:
Read-only board tree construction. Both wrappers carry one identical inline Node program between the markers '// moe board snapshot program' and '// end of the moe board snapshot program': sh board_snapshot_node (heredoc MOE_WT_BOARD_JS), ps1 Invoke-MoeBoardSnapshot ($js literal here-string, ASCII-only for the 5.1 pipe).
- Inherited GIT_DIR/WORK_TREE/INDEX_FILE/COMMON_DIR/OBJECT_DIRECTORY/... are stripped. The private index and temp copies live in an os.tmpdir() mkdtemp dir that is removed in finally.
- The parent comes from refs/moe/board^{commit}; only 100644 board entries are kept and any other parent entry is dropped.
- Only .moe/project.json, .moe/tasks/*.json and .moe/epics/*.json, as regular files. A linked or junction directory, or an unreadable one, skips the snapshot (MOE_BOARD_SNAPSHOT_SKIPPED); an absent directory keeps its entries.
- Each file is read once into a Buffer and validated (lstat before and after the read: ino, size, mtime). UTF-8 fatal decode plus JSON.parse run on that Buffer. The blob id is computed in-process, and only changed buffers are written to owned temp copies, then hash-object -w --no-filters --stdin-paths; a mismatched id throws.
- Torn, unreadable, raced or link files keep the parent blob (a new one stays out) and are named, escaped, in MOE_BOARD_FILE_KEPT.
- A deletion counts only when the name is absent from a successful readdir and an lstat recheck returns ENOENT.

Scope note: the tests live in scripts/tests/postflight-worktree.cjs, the one shared worktree suite that both postflight.sh (l.1257) and postflight.ps1 (l.1238) run, as WT-07/08/11 did. postflight.sh/.ps1 themselves are unchanged.

New cases:
- board-snapshot: helper level, under core.autocrlf=true. Byte-exact CRLF/UTF-8 blobs; non-board, runtime, subdir, tmp and txt paths excluded; unchanged board writes no commit; torn old/new; deletion; linked dir skips. A .moe and control-index signature (paths, modes, sizes, mtimes, bytes, the index file, refs/heads, HEAD) is unchanged.
- board-race, board-push and wt-board: see steps 2-3.
- wt-control-seats: QA now writes refs/moe/board, architect does not.

RED, against the pre-change wrappers: all 4 new cases and wt-control-seats failed for the expected reason. GREEN on bash: 6/6 ok.

Mutants, all killed: no --no-filters, 1 attempt, no delete, follow link, drop torn, --force push, commit unchanged.

Edits made with the Edit tool (the global rail) rather than an mv-swap. Dirty paths from other sessions (.moe/roles, .moe/skills, .moe/tasks, .moe/decisions) were left untouched.

implementationPlan.description: 2. Publish only the board ref with bounded CAS and best-effort push (DoD 2–3). In each of at most three attempts, reread the current board tip and rebuild from that parent's tree so invalid-file fallbacks come from the winner, not a stale old snapshot. `write-tree`; if equal to parent's tree (or empty tree when unborn and no board data), create no commit/ref. Otherwise `commit-tree TREE -p OLD` (omit parent when unborn), message exactly `board: <taskId> <status>`, then `update-ref refs/moe/board NEW OLD` with the all-zero old OID for first creation. Git errors are not proof the ref is unborn. On CAS loss, retry from the newly read parent; exhaustion or tree/commit/ref operational failure emits MOE_BOARD_SNAPSHOT_SKIPPED and returns a non-fatal snapshot result. Never invoke hooks, reset an index, checkout a ref, or move main/task/control branches. A successful snapshot (or an existing unchanged board ref) may attempt `git push origin refs/moe/board:refs/moe/board` once, never force/rebase; failure/no remote emits MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED and keeps local board history. Do not fetch/merge remote board divergence or change task receipt/ledger state. Give subprocess calls finite time/output bounds, dispose only owned temp resources in finally, and make JSON/filesystem/Git exceptions take the same non-fatal error handling path. Tests in both harnesses cover initial parentless commit, subsequent exact parent/message, unchanged board no new commit, one CAS race then success, three CAS losses with competing commits preserved, injected write-tree/commit-tree failure, and rejected/unreachable push with local ref retained. Assert main/task refs and source bytes stay unchanged in every helper-only scenario.
implementationPlan.note:
Publishing only the board ref (in the same shared program as step 1).
- At most 3 attempts. Each one re-reads the tip with `rev-parse -q --verify refs/moe/board`: exit 1 means unborn, any other failure throws.
- Each attempt rebuilds on that tip's tree, so a torn file falls back to the winner's blob.
- A tree equal to the parent's tree, or no board at all on an unborn ref, writes nothing.
- Otherwise `commit-tree TREE [-p OLD] -m 'board: <task> <status>'` (control chars become '?'), then `update-ref -m <msg> refs/moe/board NEW OLD`.
  - For first creation OLD is the empty string, which git documents as "must not exist". It is equivalent to the all-zero OID and also safe on sha256 (verified: a second create fails "reference already exists").
- Exhaustion, and any write-tree/commit-tree/ls-tree/hash-object failure, end in one `[WARN] MOE_BOARD_SNAPSHOT_SKIPPED: <why>`, exit 0.
- No hooks run: commit-tree and update-ref run none, and the push uses --no-verify. No index reset, no checkout, no branch moves.
- Push: once, after a snapshot or an unchanged existing ref, as plain `git push --no-verify origin refs/moe/board:refs/moe/board` (120s timeout, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0).
  - With no origin: `[info] MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED: no origin remote`.
  - A rejected or unreachable push prints `[WARN] MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED: <the rejected/fatal line>` and keeps the local ref.
- No fetch, no merge, no ledger change. Every git call has a 60s timeout (push 120s) and maxBuffer 256 MiB.
- The temp dir is removed in finally.

Tests:
- board-race (a --require shim on child_process.spawnSync lands competitor commits right before update-ref):
  - 1 loss, then success on the winner;
  - 3 losses keep all competitors chained, the ref stays the last one, and SKIPPED is printed;
  - fail-write-tree and fail-commit-tree each print SKIPPED with the ref unchanged.
- board-push:
  - pushed when it fast-forwards;
  - a divergent origin is rejected, prints UNPUSHED, and leaves both the local and remote refs as they were (no force);
  - an unreachable origin prints UNPUSHED and keeps the local ref.
- snap() now asserts the read-only signature (.moe bytes/modes/mtimes, the control index file, refs/heads, HEAD) around every helper run.

Results:
- bash: board-snapshot, board-race and board-push ok.
- Windows node.exe, ps1 platform, PS 5.1: wt-control-seats, board-snapshot, board-race, board-push, wt-board and codes, 6 ok, 0 failed (EXIT=0).

implementationPlan.description: 3. Wire snapshots only into worktree-mode post-flight (DoD 1,4–5). Reuse the landed wrapper's effective mode and canonical control-root resolution. Call the helper once after confirmed completion L12, never before publication or while its result is unknown; snapshot after task-bound QA post-flight as well (QA remains in control and need not own W), including approval and rejection board updates. No taskless notification run, worker checkpoint, failed/unpublished completion, or shared-mode path gains a snapshot. Gate it on existing settings.commitBoardState, default true; false does not invoke the helper or push. Pass actual task id/status read for that post-flight. Snapshot and push failure cannot alter LAND_OUTCOME/the PS result, ledger/finalization, task branch sync, or release cleanup; no board commit is reported as a task completion. Keep existing shared BOARD attribution untouched. Add twin end-to-end postflight cases: worktree completion C changes no .moe path while refs/moe/board contains the control records; QA post-flight refreshes the ref; false setting leaves board ref absent/unchanged; injected snapshot/push failures still leave the completion truthfully landed. Reuse existing fake proxy without changing it; helper-level cases supply their own static board fixtures. Record all actual changed files only, retain existing shared BOARD tests and held-out worktree-landing tests byte-for-byte.
implementationPlan.note:
Wiring, worktree mode only.
- sh worktree_postflight / ps1 Invoke-MoeWorktreePostflight: right after land_worktree_completion / Invoke-MoeWorktreeCompletion returns with outcome committed (L12 done in wt_land_published) or nothing, call board_snapshot / Invoke-MoeBoardSnapshot with $PREFLIGHT_TASK_ID / $preflightTaskId and the post-flight status.
  - failed, refused, unknown-push and unlanded outcomes never call it.
- sh control_seat_postflight / ps1 Invoke-MoeControlSeatPostflight: when the role is qa, call it after the nothing row, with the post-flight status.
  - This runs for approve and reject alike, and QA needs no W.
  - Architect seats do not snapshot.
- The gate is autoCommit && commitBoardState (both default on). With false, the helper and the push never run.
- The helper's output is printed only. LAND_OUTCOME, the PS $res, the ledger, finalize, the task-branch sync and the lease release are all done before it runs, and it changes none of them.
- The board commit is never a record_commit row.
- Shared mode cannot reach it: both call sites are in the worktree and control-seat arms only. The shared BOARD tier code is unchanged, and postflight.sh/.ps1 are unchanged.

Tests:
- wt-board, end-to-end on both harnesses:
  1. A completion: C changes no .moe path; refs/moe/board's tree equals the control's task, epic and project.json blobs; the message is 'board: task-postflight REVIEW'; the completion row is committed.
  2. A QA DONE post-flight adds a commit (parent = 1, 'board: … DONE').
  3. commitBoardState=false: the ref is unchanged and no MOE_BOARD_ or board line is printed.
  4. refs/moe/board pointing at a blob: a completion still lands (committed row, finalize landed, exit 0), prints SKIPPED, and the ref stays.
- wt-checkpoint and wt-fails (4 failure modes) now assert that no board ref is written.

Mutants in a scratch snapshot, all killed:
- no setting gate (wt-board);
- snapshot on any outcome (wt-fails);
- no QA call (wt-control-seats, wt-board).

bash results: wt-checkpoint, wt-completion, wt-fails, wt-unlanded and wt-board, 5/5 ok.

The diff vs HEAD is +374/-8 (net 366) over 3 files.

implementationPlan.description: 4. Single final verification gate. From root run exactly `node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh`. Require safe failureClass NONE, held-out cases green, parity PASS and exit 0. On native Windows run `node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell` on the identical revision; PS5.1 is required, skips/unavailable engines are not success. Compare sorted grep -oE sets for `MOE_(WORKTREE|LAND|CONTROL|BOARD)_[A-Z0-9_]+` between wrappers. Preserve safe-output handling; never expose raw postflight fixture logs. Load regression-check/verification-before-completion and retain fresh command, exitCode, safe outputTail and Windows results for complete_task. The held-out scripts are prerequisite outputs not new/edit targets; compare to WT-08T's landed version read-only. No full unrelated daemon/plugin gate or docs sweep in this mid-epic slice.

implementationPlan.description: 5. Final adversarial self-review, once. Load adversarial-self-review. Attack parse→read races, unreadable directories looking deleted, invalid JSON during daemon writes, symlink/junction substitution, untracked runtime files, hostile path/newline characters, CRLF/filter conversion, corrupt parent ref, two simultaneous snapshotters and remote rejection. Assert every hashed blob comes from the exact parsed Buffer; an uncertain read preserves its latest-parent blob; every retry recomputes against the actual latest board ref; .moe content/mtimes and real indexes are untouched; no main write/force push/rollback can occur. Confirm the two embedded programs are equivalent, source/control root is used not W, QA needs no W, false commitBoardState causes no work, and board errors never rewrite task delivery success. Keep <=400 net LOC without dropping the requested tests. Preserve PS BOM/CRLF and atomic Bash save requirements. If fixes arise refresh the same gate, then complete via Moe with accurate modifiedFiles and fresh evidence; wrapper owns Git writes. Docs remain WT-17/18.
implementationPlan.note:
Adversarial self-review, done once over `git diff -- scripts/moe-agent.sh scripts/moe-agent.ps1 scripts/tests/postflight-worktree.cjs`. No defects found, so no code changed and the step-4 gate evidence stands for the same bytes (sh f3691313, ps1 7e47cecb, cjs 545cc402).

Checked and holding:
- Parse→read races: one read into a Buffer, with lstat before and after (ino, size, mtime) and length checks; the blob id is hashed in-process from those exact bytes, and git hash-object of an owned temp copy (--no-filters) must agree.
- An uncertain read (link, not a regular file, torn, not UTF-8 or not JSON, ENOENT) keeps the parent blob and is named in MOE_BOARD_FILE_KEPT.
- An unreadable directory throws, so the snapshot is SKIPPED and nothing reads as deleted. A deletion needs absence from a successful readdir plus an ENOENT recheck.
- A link or junction for .moe, tasks or epics: SKIPPED.
- Daemon atomic-write temps end in `.tmp`, so the `*.json` filter excludes them. The runtime dirs are never read.
- Hostile names: update-index -z, a [\s\S] ls-tree parse, and esc/ascii in the log. The commit message strips control characters.
- CRLF: --no-filters, tested with autocrlf=true.
- A corrupt parent (blob ref) leads to SKIPPED while the landing stays landed (tested).
- Each of the 3 CAS attempts re-reads the tip and rebuilds (race1 and race3 tested).
- Remote rejection: a plain push, never --force, gives MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED (tested). --no-verify matches the plan's "Never invoke hooks"; the agent git guard is not inherited (agent_git_exec subshell only).
- The sig check asserts .moe content and mtimes and the real index are untouched around every run.
- The two programs are asserted identical. Root is $PROJECT/$projectPath, set only at startup; no W reference. QA needs no W.
- commitBoardState=false or autoCommit=false returns before node.
- board_snapshot always returns 0, touches no LAND_* state, and the ps1 result is discarded via $null.
- 366 net LOC. ps1 BOM kept and 0 CR, as at HEAD.

Theoretical only, not fixed:
(a) Swapping a parent directory for a link between lstat and readdir needs a hostile writer inside the trusted control checkout.
(b) A board ref that diverged on origin (another machine) stays MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED; the plan forbids fetch and merge.
(c) A file that vanishes between readdir and read is kept, named (ENOENT), and dropped by the next snapshot.
(d) A lost CAS leaves unreferenced objects for gc.
(e) The push is bounded at 120s.
(f) Under PS 5.1 an empty TaskId would be dropped from native argv. That path is unreachable: post-flight runs only with a non-empty preflight task id (ps1 l.9886, sh l.10567).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
# Worktree board-history snapshots
Goal: record control-checkout board JSON on refs/moe/board without touching main or daemon files. Architecture: new board_snapshot / Invoke-MoeBoardSnapshot twins drive isolated Git plumbing, with JSON read once and snapshotted as exact bytes. Keep this in the two already-bundled wrappers, using an identical small inline Node program invoked with argv (existing Node runtime), rather than a new script requiring two packaging-manifest edits. No new dependencies or files. Tech: Bash, PS5.1, Node fs/child_process, Git temporary index and CAS.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Verified design §4 specifies CAS board ref, complete board snapshot, invalid JSON retaining old blob, and best-effort push. §1.1 restricts worktree mode to a repository-root project (MOE_REL empty), so paths are root-relative .moe/...; QA stays in control checkout. Existing shared attribution/Build-MoeTempIndexTree helpers git-add live files after hashing and therefore must not be reused to re-read a file after validating it. Use immutable captured buffers/temp copies and hash-object --no-filters to avoid TOCTOU and CRLF normalization. JetBrains build.gradle.kts and VS Code bundle-assets.mjs explicitly enumerate mjs assets, so adding a shared helper would make this seven files; embedded identical Node keeps the requested four-file scope. Current wrapper source lacks prerequisite WT-11 worktree integration; read its landed arm, do not reconstruct it here.
planningNotes.risks: Four files, one best-effort history feature, target <=60min and <=400 net LOC via identical compact Node payload and table-driven tests. No source edits during planning. User delegated deletion policy: confirmed deleted JSON disappears from next snapshot; invalid/unreadable JSON retains parent blob. A disappearing file after enumeration is uncertain and retains parent; directory enumeration failure must never look like mass deletion. Snapshot is not a cross-file database transaction. Never stage live .moe, invoke filters/hooks, inherit a caller index, force-push, or turn successful task delivery into failure. Read mem:gotcha-eol-normalization-shared-index and mem:convention-postflight-scratch-harness. Preserve PS BOM/CRLF and use syntax-checked same-filesystem atomic replacement for Bash. Safe postflight gate required.

completionSummary:
WT-12: board history snapshots on refs/moe/board. Twin helpers: sh board_snapshot (board_snapshot_node) and ps1 Invoke-MoeBoardSnapshot. Both embed one identical Node program, and the tests assert the two copies are equal.
- Reads: .moe/project.json, .moe/tasks/*.json and .moe/epics/*.json in the control root. Each file is one Buffer read with lstat before and after, a fatal UTF-8 decode and JSON.parse. Exactly those bytes are hashed; hash-object runs with --no-filters on a private index in a temp dir.
- Invalid, torn or link files keep the parent blob and are named in MOE_BOARD_FILE_KEPT. Deletion needs a successful readdir plus an ENOENT recheck; a linked or unreadable dir skips the snapshot.
- Writes: commit-tree -p tip ('board: <task> <status>'), then an update-ref CAS with 3 attempts; exhaustion or any error prints MOE_BOARD_SNAPSHOT_SKIPPED. An unchanged tree writes no commit. A plain push follows (no force, no hooks); a rejection or failure prints MOE_BOARD_UNPUSHED.
- Wiring: after a worktree completion landing whose outcome is committed or nothing, and after a QA control-seat post-flight. Gated by autoCommit and commitBoardState. Shared mode is unchanged. The snapshot never alters the landing outcome.
- Tests in postflight-worktree.cjs, run by both postflight harnesses:
  - new cases: board-snapshot, board-race, board-push, wt-board;
  - updated: wt-control-seats, wt-checkpoint, wt-fails.
  - Every run asserts .moe content and mtimes and the real index are unchanged.
  - RED was shown before the change; 10 mutants were killed.
- Net 366 LOC. ps1 BOM kept, 0 CR.
- Verification, same bytes:
  - bash safe gate: NONE, last scenario Z.
  - worktree-landing: 18/18.
  - parity-check: PASS.
  - Native Windows `node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell` (PS 5.1): failureClass NONE, exit 0.
  - The MOE_(WORKTREE|LAND|CONTROL|BOARD)_ code sets are identical in both wrappers (28 codes).
  - Held-out worktree-landing.sh and .ps1 are unchanged from WT-08T.
- Theo
